title: How Delhi Cut Electricity Loss from 50 to 5 Percent
summary: The article from IEEE Spectrum documents how Delhi dramatically reduced electricity transmission and distribution losses from 50% to 5% through a combination of infrastructure modernization, smart metering deployment, and regulatory reforms, transforming one of the world's most inefficient power systems into a model of efficiency.
problem_solved: Solved the problem of massive electricity loss and wastage in Delhi's power distribution network that was costing billions and causing unreliable service.
why_valuable: This case demonstrates how developing regions can achieve dramatic infrastructure improvements through systematic reform and technology deployment, providing a blueprint for other cities facing similar energy efficiency challenges.
